question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who examines a company’s financial records
solution:
The correct answer is "**Auditor**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• One word substitution is the use of one word in place of a wordy phrase in order to make the sentence structure clearer.
 
• The meaning, with the replacement of the phrase remains identical while the sentence becomes shorter.
 
 
• For example: One who loves his country: Patriot.
 
 
 
• In the same way, to substitute the group of words "One who examines a company's financial record", let us understand the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• Conductor means a person in charge of a public means of transportation (as a train) ; a person or thing that directs or leads.
 
 
• ***Example**: The woman **conductor k**indly responded to my question.*
 
 
 
• Author means a person who writes a book, play, etc..
 
 
• ***Example**: My favorite **author **is Munshi Premchand.*
 
 
 
• Auditor means a person authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records.
 
 
• ***Example**: The accounts were certified by an** auditor.***
 
 
 
• Instructor means someone whose job is to teach a practical skill or a sport.
 
 
• ***Example**: Rahul is a certified fitness** instructor.***
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above-explained meanings, it can be inferred that "Auditor" is the required word.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3) Auditor.
